key_takeaway: Verify the dose/unit basis before booking — a private clinic's 'full face' quote may legitimately include 2-3x the product of a factory-tier single-syringe price.

key_takeaway: Imported brands cost noticeably more for marginal, patient-dependent differences — a domestic brand is a reasonable default unless you have a specific reason to want an imported one.

average_price_range_krw: N/A (adds ~10% to any quote that says 부가세 별도 / VAT-separate)
foreigner_friendly_check: Ask directly: '이 가격에 부가세 포함인가요?' (Is VAT included in this price?) — many advertised prices for non-insurance (비급여) aesthetic procedures do not include the 10% VAT by default.
key_takeaway: A quote that looks 10% cheaper than a competitor's may just be VAT-exclusive — always confirm before comparing two clinics' prices directly.

foreigner_friendly_check: Refusing card payment or charging a card surcharge is illegal in Korea (여신전문금융업법) — you have the legal right to pay the listed price by card.
key_takeaway: Treat an aggressive push toward a 'cash discount' as a signal to ask more questions, not a bonus — paying by card also gives you a dispute trail if something goes wrong.
